en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘A man knocked at the door of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and his teknonym was Abu Murra. So when he sought permission to (see) him<sup>asws</sup>, he was saying, ‘Abu Murra is at the door’. So Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! When you come to our<sup>asws</sup> door, so do not be saying ‘Abu Murra’’.
en.sarwar: 17. Muhammad ibn al-Husayn has narrated from Ja‘far ibn Bashir from ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who has said the following:

“I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘A man would come to Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and his Kunyah was abu Murrah. When asking for permission at the door he would say, ‘This is abu Murrah at the door.’ Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said to him, ‘I swear you to Allah that when you come to our door do not say, ‘This is abu Murrah at the door (it is Kunyah of Satan).”’
